local_note: Chatsworth homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for Chatsworth's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout Chatsworth, including Chatsworth, Porter Ranch adjacent, Chatsworth Hills, and nearby neighborhoods. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Chatsworth?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Chatsworth building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Chatsworth?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Chatsworth rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Chatsworth remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
